variants.detail: A MONOLITH: tall narrow vertical wedge breech counterweight, flanked by two dramatically sloped ivory monolithic cheek shields with open negative space beneath, on a compact graphite gimbal. Strong black-white-sand color blocking, upper sculpture reads like a modern precision industrial instrument; tall angular rear upper group, not a tank turret.
